evidence.label: Balance-sheet identity
evidence.claim: Reserves fell $30.4B on the week to $2,895B, and the ledger says where from: the TGA rebuilt $17.2B, the residual absorbed $14.5B, the balance sheet added $6.3B, six legs summing to the reserve change to the dollar with $37.5B of the balance sheet, 0.56% of assets, still sitting in the unnamed residual.

evidence.label: Official-sector footprint
evidence.claim: Foreign officials cut their Fed custody Treasuries by $45.7B over 13 weeks while foreign RRP parking rose by $33.5B, only a partial rotation because the combined official footprint still fell $12.2B to $2,958B, 27% of the custody drop leaving the official sector rather than moving inside it.
evidence.source: Federal Reserve custody and foreign RRP
